title: Meditative+ balance changes and the Float keyword
notes: R1563000: Float, a turn's unspent mana, and Float reduces cost; R1563001: Expedition12's Radiant Cleave on its hand pick; R1563002: Spell Damage on a face-up Field Spell counts; R1563003: Bob's Plan Discovers Aestheticize the Game's plans; R1563004: Mountaintop Garden's Radiant price reaches every card that isn't Radiant; R1563005, R1563006: KY's Competition's AI accuracy and 60-second sequence; R1563007 to R1563009: the craft offer, Spell potions and no Gain Armor block; R1563010: Scratch Pad's code.

player.title: Meditative+ balance changes and Float
new: Float: the mana a player leaves unspent at the end of their turn. A card with "Float reduces cost" costs that much less.
Garage Sale, a (1) Spell AI generated card: fill your hand with Coins, then discard your hand.
Leg Day, a (2) Spell AI generated card: give your Units +5/+5.
balance: Book of Buff buffs 4 times, down from 5, and 8 times on its Radiant face, down from 10.
Aestheticize the Game costs (0), down from (1).
Meditative Journey and Journey Complete cost (1), down from (2).
GIGA Glowy Jelly Bean costs (7), up from (6), and gains "Float reduces cost".
Expedition12 loses (2) mana next turn instead of all of it, and its Radiant face has Cleave instead of Echo 1.
Expedition123 loses (2) mana next turn, then (3) the turn after, instead of all of it for two turns.
Devil's Pact is Indestructible with Spell Damage +1, +2 on its Radiant face.
A crafted Potion is a Spell with no stats and 4 points to spend, down from 7; a HUGE Potion has 20, down from 35.
changes: YileGPT Tamed is now YileGPT, and its Death shuffles a YileGPT Prime into your deck.
YileGPT Unleashed is now YileGPT Prime, and Float reduces its cost.
Bread and Butter reveals when any player Floats and summons a Bread Token the size of the Float.
Bob's Plan lets you Discover the plan for Aestheticize the Game: a Spa Day, a Garage Sale or a Leg Day.
KY's Competition ends after 60 seconds, against the AI as in a match; the AI answers right 85% of the time, 93% Radiant.
Crafting offers 4 keywords, 2 hats and 3 effects to build from, as Kazakus does, and giving your hero Armor is no longer an effect.
Scratch Pad is coded in a text editor: type the card's code, and Craft makes it.
Spell Damage on a face-up Field Spell now adds to your Spells.
fixes: Mountaintop Garden lets you play any card that isn't Radiant as Radiant for its extra price, not only Embiggen cards.
